ترتشفون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشِفُونَ (tartašifūna) /tar.ta.ʃi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# تُرْتَشَفُونَ (turtašafūna) /tur.ta.ʃa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
